description: Read last news launch outcome after draft-safe fix

steps.name: news-draft-fix-outcome
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$l=[string](Get-Content $f -Tail 150 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'LAUNCH CONFIRMED|LAUNCH FAILED|CHAT LAUNCH LOG ERROR' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';last=$l.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(900,$l.Length))}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
